# Design Motion Atlas v5.0 (josuva777/design-motion-atlas)
> Omni-Domain Anti-Slop Design System, Awwwards Motion Engine, Tactile Mobile Library, Programmatic Lyric/Reel Video Studio, and AG-UI/A2UI Agentic Workspace.
## Instant Autonomous Install Commands (Top Priority)
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add josuva777/design-motion-atlas/all -y
npm run init:project -- --name "MyProject" --archetype 11-kinetic-lyric-reel-studio
```
## Domain Capabilities & Working Samples
- **01-10 Web, Mobile & Telemetry**: See `samples/awwwards-flagship-launch/SpatialFlagshipSample.tsx`, `samples/zomato-quick-commerce/ZomatoFoodFlowSample.tsx`, `samples/fintech-ledger-workspace/LedgerReconciliationSample.tsx`, and `samples/art-atelier-exhibition/AtelierArchiveSample.tsx`.
- **11 Reels, Shorts & Song Lyric Videos**: See `blocks/video-studio/KineticLyricReelComposition.tsx`, `blocks/video-studio/OpusClipCaptionStage.tsx`, and `samples/lyric-reel-studio/ViralLyricReelSample.tsx`.
- **12 Multi-Agent AG-UI & Google A2UI Surfaces**: See `blocks/agentic-ui/A2UISurfaceRenderer.tsx` and `samples/agentic-command-center/AgenticWorkspaceSample.tsx`.
